name: elicit
description: Brainstorm a vision to completion — you talk, it questions the gaps you leave and guides you through the parts you do not fully understand yet. Orients from the project knowledge base and the .steward/ model before the first question so it never re-asks what is settled, recurses on every deeper gap an answer opens, panels genuine forks with prism, and lands conclusions as steward inbox captures — never a direct model edit. One skill, zero code, no preconditions.
